changes.formula: If(varReqBusy, "Loading saved requests…", If(!IsBlank(varReqError), varReqError, Switch(varReqTab, "Sent", "Sent requests: waiting for a reply. Select one to view or withdraw it.", "Received", "Received requests: select an invitation to accept or decline.", "Group incoming", "Group requests: review invitations to join your groups.", "History", "History: requests that were accepted, declined or withdrawn.", "Choose Sent, Received, Group incoming or History.")))
changes.previous: =If(varReqBusy, "Loading saved requests…", If(!IsBlank(varReqError), varReqError, "Review requests you sent or received. Select a request for details and available actions."))

changes.formula: Switch(varReqTab, "Sent", "No sent requests. Invitations you send appear here.", "Received", "No received invitations. To find requests you sent, choose Sent.", "Group incoming", "No requests to join your groups.", "History", "No accepted, declined or withdrawn requests yet.", "Choose a request view.")

If(IsBlank(varReqSelected.requestId), "Select a request to see its details", If(varReqSelected.requestType = "Personal", "Personal invitation #", "Group join request #") & Text(varReqSelected.requestId))
"Request status, date and introduction where provided"

If(IsBlank(varReqSelected.requestId), "",
    If(varReqSelected.processing,
    "Accepted. Your exchange is being set up. Refresh to check progress.",
    Switch(varReqSelected.status,
        "Pending", If(varReqSelected.direction = "Sent", "Waiting for a reply.", "Waiting for your response."),
        "Accepted", "Accepted.",
        "Declined", "Declined.",
        "Cancelled", If(varReqSelected.direction = "Sent", "You withdrew this request.", "The sender withdrew this request."),
        varReqSelected.status)) & Char(10) &
    "Sent: " & IfError(Text(DateTimeValue(varReqSelected.created), DateTimeFormat.ShortDateTime), "Date unavailable") &
    If(varReqSelected.status = "Pending" && varReqSelected.availability = "UnavailablePending",
        Char(10) & "The person or group is no longer available. You can still withdraw or decline where offered.", "") &
    If(varReqSelected.requestType = "Group" && !IsBlank(Trim(Coalesce(varReqSelected.introduction, ""))),
        Char(10) & Char(10) & "Introduction" & Char(10) & varReqSelected.introduction, ""))
changes.previous: =If(IsBlank(varReqSelected.requestId), "", varReqSelected.direction & " · " & varReqSelected.status & Char(10) & "Created: " & varReqSelected.created & Char(10) & "Availability: " & varReqSelected.availability & Char(10) & "Completion: " & If(varReqSelected.processing, "Processing; membership completion is not confirmed", If(varReqSelected.completed, "Complete", "Not complete")) & Char(10) & Char(10) & "Introduction" & Char(10) & Coalesce(varReqSelected.introduction, ""))

changes.formula: If(varReqDialog = "New intent", "Review before starting a new action", varReqDialog = "Cancel", "Withdraw request #" & Text(varReqSelected.requestId) & "?", varReqDialog & " request #" & Text(varReqSelected.requestId))
changes.previous: =If(varReqDialog = "New intent", "Review before starting a new action", varReqDialog & " request #" & Text(varReqSelected.requestId))
